items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: My nephew is the one who was interviewed for that. George.

ctx.x: About two or three years they had it there. Yes.
And I remember they told us that they had nothing. My nephew is the one who was interviewed for that. George.
That picture that was taken there, yes. Yes.
